title: Around the World in Eighty Days
summary: Phileas Fogg, a wealthy British gentleman living in London, makes an outrageous wager that he can travel around the world in just eighty days. Accompanied by his valet Passepartout, he embarks on a dizzying journey across continents and oceans, encountering delays from weather, railway strikes, Indian mutiny, and mistaken identity as a bank robber. With each challenge, Fogg’s precise planning is tested, but his unflappable nature keeps him on track. Along the way, he rescues an Indian woman named Aouda from a sacrificial death, falls in love with her, and ultimately triumphs by arriving at the Reform Club in London just minutes before the deadline—winning his bet and gaining personal happiness.
